mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO cms_activity_settlement_hold (activity_id, registration_id, status, create_time) SELECT r.owner_id, r.id, 0, NOW() FROM cms_registration r WHERE r.owner_type = 2 AND r.owner_id = #{activityId} AND r.payment_status = 2 AND r.registration_status = 2 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coop_complaint c WHERE c.registration_id = r.id AND c.del_flag = 0 AND c.status < 3 )
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(r.payable_amount), 0) FROM cms_activity_settlement_hold h JOIN cms_registration r ON r.id = h.registration_id WHERE h.activity_id = #{activityId} AND h.status = 0 AND r.payment_status = 2 AND r.registration_status = 2

SELECT h.id, h.activity_id, h.registration_id, h.status FROM cms_activity_settlement_hold h WHERE h.status = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM coop_complaint c WHERE c.registration_id = h.registration_id AND c.del_flag = 0 AND c.status < 3 ) ORDER BY h.id LIMIT 500
mapper.update: UPDATE cms_activity_settlement_hold SET status = #{toStatus}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cms_activity_settlement_hold WHERE registration_id = #{registrationId} AND status = 0 FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM coop_complaint WHERE registration_id = #{registrationId} AND del_flag = 0 AND status < 3 FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: SELECT DISTINCT registration_id FROM coop_complaint WHERE del_flag = 0 AND status < 3 AND registration_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS activityId, a.topic_id AS topicId, a.end_date AS endDate, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN oc.registration_id IS NULL THEN r.payable_amount END), 0) AS normalSales, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN oc.registration_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.payable_amount END), 0) AS disputedSales, MAX(CASE WHEN r.verification_status IS NULL OR r.verification_status <> 1 THEN COALESCE(r.refund_deadline, DATE_SUB(a.start_date, INTERVAL 24 HOUR)) END) AS lastRefundDeadline FROM cms_activity a JOIN cms_registration r ON r.owner_type = 2 AND r.owner_id = a.id AND r.payment_status = 2 AND r.registration_status = 2 LEFT JOIN () oc ON oc.registration_id = r.id WHERE a.member_id = #{memberId} AND a.del_flag = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND a.is_settlement = 0 AND (a.topic_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cms_topic t WHERE t.id = a.topic_id AND t.product_type = 2)) GROUP BY a.id, a.topic_id, a.end_date

SELECT a.id AS activityId, a.topic_id AS topicId, a.end_date AS endDate, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN oc.registration_id IS NULL THEN r.payable_amount END), 0) AS normalSales, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN oc.registration_id IS NOT NULL THEN r.payable_amount END), 0) AS disputedSales FROM cms_activity_settlement_hold h JOIN cms_activity a ON a.id = h.activity_id JOIN cms_registration r ON r.id = h.registration_id AND r.payment_status = 2 AND r.registration_status = 2 LEFT JOIN () oc ON oc.registration_id = r.id WHERE h.status = 0 AND a.member_id = #{memberId} GROUP BY a.id, a.topic_id, a.end_date
